title: Scope the TermAl remote-notification and mailbox-eligibility slice for Git task sync, after Engram's Git-only proof
outcome: A separately scoped, testable TermAl slice that carries Engram's push-confirmed task-sync notification to a remote-backed root session of the same control plane. It covers mailbox eligibility for remote-backed proxy roots, wakes over the existing session-scoped proxy route, and the coordination-upstream relay from docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md "Planned remote access". It has no federation between independent control planes and no remote credit. It starts only after Engram's Git-only export/import proof has fixed the exchange contract.
acceptance: A design note names the Engram exchange contract it builds on (the Git-only vertical slice's landed commit and its notification shape) and lists the exact TermAl changes, each with file paths: eligibility, wake routing, the coordination upstream and its pinned remote-lease semantics.

The note states explicitly that there is no federation between independent control planes, no remote or imported host credit, no root rebinding, and no background network activity (Greg #516), and that Git-only discovery at the next explicit fetch remains the fallback.

The note proposes fail-first tests for each change that run without a real second machine, and someone other than the author concurs on the slice's acceptance criteria before implementation is claimed.
